definitions.gloss: captain; skipper; master of a ship
definitions.explanation: The person in command of a ship or boat. Responsible for the vessel's navigation, safety, and crew.

examples.japanese: {船長|せんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
{船長|せんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The captain is responsible for the safety of the passengers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{船長|せんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}して→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧な⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{導|みちび}いた→導く：12361_michibiku⟧。
examples.english: In the storm, the captain made calm decisions and guided the ship to a safe harbor.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧ (ship) + {長|ちょう} (chief, head). Used for captains of ships of all sizes, from fishing boats to large vessels. In fiction (especially manga and anime), also used as a form of address: {船長|せんちょう}!

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船長|せんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ (the captain's orders)
- {船長|せんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as captain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機長|きちょう}→機長：22199_kichou⟧: pilot in command — the equivalent for aircraft
- {艦長|かんちょう}: commanding officer of a warship — military usage
